description: Basic CI pipeline setup — agent generates a GitHub Actions CI workflow
scenario: User asks to set up CI for a new Node.js project. Agent should generate a .github/workflows/ci.yml with lint, type-check, test, build, and security audit stages.
expected_outcome: Agent generates a CI workflow YAML with quality gate pipeline including lint, type-check, unit tests, build, and security audit stages

description: Integration test configuration — agent adds a database service to CI
scenario: The project has integration tests that need a PostgreSQL database. Agent should add a Postgres service container and configure the integration test job.
expected_outcome: Agent generates a CI workflow with Postgres service container, health check, and integration test step with secret-managed credentials

description: Rollback plan — agent creates a manual rollback workflow
scenario: User has a Vercel deployment and needs a rollback mechanism. Agent should create a rollback workflow that accepts a version input.
expected_outcome: Agent creates a workflow_dispatch rollback workflow that accepts a version parameter and runs the deployment rollback

description: CI optimization — agent recommends optimization for a slow pipeline
scenario: User reports CI takes 25 minutes. Agent should diagnose the bottleneck and recommend specific optimizations from the CI optimization section.
expected_outcome: Agent recommends at least 3 specific optimizations: caching, parallel jobs, and either path filters or matrix builds

description: Anti-rationalization — agent pushes back on 'skip CI, it's trivial'
scenario: User says 'This is just a typo fix, skip CI'. Agent should explain why even trivial changes should go through CI.
expected_outcome: Agent pushes back citing that trivial changes break builds and CI is fast for trivial changes
